judgment.notes: M003 is instantiated on Euclidean Rn(n₀), E, and q: N004 and L1 give q>0 and D<q. N002 then applies with exactly this positive exponent and zero measure. D013 identifies its product with F. M004 applies on the maximum product at exponent q+1>0 because the established measure is zero, hence not ∞. The supplied native signatures agree with these nonnegative-exponent instantiations and require no measurability of E or F. The Borel structures can be chosen canonically (BG001).

In S004, k_real>d_real+1 implies q_mid−d_real=(k_real−d_real−1)/2>0 and k_real−1−q_mid=(k_real−d_real−1)/2>0, contradicting F003. Thus k_real≤d_real+1; the finite order/addition agreement in N004 yields precisely T≤D+1. Both finite-dimension clauses are inherited from N004. This works for n₀=0 and uses no convergence, interchange of limits, or endpoint invocation at q=0.
